artifacts.notes: The response contains the complete numbered Latin body, followed by the promulgation formula, date, papal signature, and a subscription block that stops at Paul Peter Meouchi and omits the later Acta signatories, continuation notice, and notarial attestations; its sole conciliar footnote follows that block. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.

edition.notes: A dated Vatican delivery state of the Latin Decree. The registered response contains articles 1-24, followed by the promulgation formula, date, papal signature, and an incomplete subscription block ending with Paul Peter Meouchi; its sole conciliar footnote follows that block. The numbered body and appended apparatus remain distinct.
edition.publication: Holy See Latin web presentation of Inter mirifica, retrieved 2026-07-24
edition.title: Inter mirifica — Vatican Latin web state

passages.context: The complete numbered Latin body was inspected as one bounded witness, from article 1 through article 24 immediately before the promulgation apparatus.
passages.notes: Verification establishes the official dated delivery and complete uninterrupted numbered extent. It excludes the promulgation and incomplete subscription appendix, is not a word-for-word critical collation, and does not imply publication-level use.

work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Decree on the Media of Social Communications, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 4 December 1963. It comprises numbered articles 1-24; edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
